title: kruzovic7/ai-data-extractor
why_read: A tool for extracting chat histories from AI coding assistants is a niche but practically useful utility for developers who use multiple coding-agent tools.
analysis: This is a utility for pulling out and presumably normalizing conversation logs from tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Aider, and Cline/Roo Code. It's useful for developers who want to archive, search, or analyze their own AI-assisted coding sessions across different tools, since each tool typically stores this data in a different proprietary format. The value is mostly practical and workflow-oriented rather than a novel technical contribution, but the multi-tool support suggests real engineering effort in reverse-engineering various storage formats. It's a modest but genuinely handy piece of developer tooling for a growing use case.
